Estimate Momentum measures change in analyst sentiment over time and may be an indicator of future price movements. The Change in Consensus chart shows the current, 1 week ago, and 1 month ago consensus earnings per share (EPS*) forecasts.
 For the fiscal quarter endingSep 2026 , the consensus EPS* forecast has remained the same over the past week at 1.99 and increased over the past month from 1.98 to 1.99(0.51%). Of the 1 analysts making quarterly forecasts, 1raised and none lowered their forecast.
 For the fiscal year ending Sep 2026 , the consensus EPS* forecast has remained the same over the past week at 8.75 and increased over the past month from 8.74 to 8.75(0.11%). Of the 1 analysts making yearly forecasts, 1raised and none lowered their forecast.
